name: Chien Kuo Construction Co., Ltd.
summary: Chien Kuo Construction Co., Ltd. engages in the construction business in Taiwan and China. The company constructs various projects, such as office buildings, hotel, residential building, education and healthcare facilities, social housing, and cultural and technology facilities. It also undertakes mechanical, electrical and plumbing, refrigeration, and air conditioning engineering projects; and offers computer software technology development and consultation services. In addition, the company engages in the trading of construction materials; and wholesale and retail of equipment. Chien Kuo Construction Co., Ltd. was founded in 1931 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
